UE 5.6 alpha.9 — compact reference-matched layout

The first Unreal React tab used a wider content column, roomier cards, oversized corner treatment and generic glyphs. The revised layout follows the proportions of the supplied reference more closely: a 970px maximum content column, tighter card spacing, 13px card corners, aligned labels and controls, and purpose-drawn blue/orange section icons. The transfer behavior, fields, confirmation buttons, official application marks and safety wording remain present.

The production page was rendered at the reference image's 1086×1448 viewport in Chromium and visually reviewed. Preview: compact Unreal panel [not indexed]. The exact interface inside the running desktop Unreal WebBrowser still requires closing and reopening the ForgeMCP tab.

Validation: React/Vite build passed; the local single-file UI verifier passed; the UE 5.6.1 clean-project package test loaded the plugin and confirmed live plugin health and MCP Unreal project identity. Native Unreal binaries did not change in this visual-only update.
